full_judgment: 2. Facts, in brief, are that the petitioner, Amigo Bangladesh Ltd, is a private limited company duly incorporated under the Companies Act of 1994, having its registered office at 14, Purana Paltan, Dhaka-1000. However, in order to do business it had purchased 65 acres of land i.e. the case property situated at Gazipur, Dhaka, under RS Khatian No. 6 and Dag Nos. 1411, 1412, 1413, 1414, 1415 and 1416 from the recorded owner namely National Jute Mills Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "NJM"), upon payment of full consideration (Annexure-A).
